tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "E6304E7B42D522B1756581A8A3032E69", "You\'ve come upon a caravan in transit. Caravans are usually carrying valuable materials or commodities between Settlements. You may wish to help defend an allied caravan, or attack an enemy caravan.")

NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "CED231894EBAA2D2CF7228B49E115A18", "Caravan PVP events have reduced death penalties and if the caravan is destroyed you can claim the loot for yourself! However, you\'re limited to what you can carry on your back unless you summon your own Carvan.")
